versions.subject: feat: updates and enhancements
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\provlaunch.exe'
selection_child:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\calc.exe'
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\mshta.exe'
        - '\notepad.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\regsvr32.exe'
        - '\rundll32.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
    - Image|contains:
        - ':\PerfLogs\'
        - ':\Temp\'
        - ':\Users\Public\'
        - '\AppData\Temp\'
        - '\Windows\System32\Tasks\'
        - '\Windows\Tasks\'
        - '\Windows\Temp\'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\provlaunch.exe" Image IN ("*\\calc.exe", "*\\cmd.exe", "*\\cscript.exe", "*\\mshta.exe", "*\\notepad.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\regsvr32.exe", "*\\rundll32.exe", "*\\wscript.exe") OR Image IN ("*:\\PerfLogs\\*", "*:\\Temp\\*", "*:\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\AppData\\Temp\\*", "*\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\*", "*\\Windows\\Tasks\\*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*")
